 When will tickets to Rock Werchter 2027 be available for sale?

Rock Werchter 2027 will take place from Thursday 1 July through Sunday 4 July at the Festivalpark in Werchter. Ticket sales start on Friday 30 October at 10 am. Register for the Rock Werchter presale for earlier access to festival tickets.
